description: Engine §4.1 and §6: a sole-child walk through two wrappers reaches the erased root and merges its interiors.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution fewest #·zz
%rule text $g:gap C
%conditions $g ≅ #wrap
%rule gap wrap
%rule wrap r2
%rule r2 (r4 ≻ B) :: ∅ | [r4]
%erased
%rule r4 B | ε
%rule zz B B B
